description:
Open viewing: Saturday 03/10/2026 from 10:00am - 10:30am

Stanley Estate Agents are delighted to present 16A Birchdale Road, Kinsealy, a beautifully renovated three-bedroom detached home combining modern interiors, newly fitted finishes throughout and a large, private south-facing rear garden. Occupying a corner plot, this impressive turnkey property extends to approximately 101 sq. m. and benefits from a C2 BER rating.

The home has been comprehensively renovated, including a new kitchen, new bathrooms, new flooring and new appliances. Fresh, contemporary décor and carefully coordinated finishes create a stylish, welcoming home that is ready to move into and enjoy. For buyers seeking modern comfort without the time and disruption of undertaking renovations, this property offers an excellent opportunity.

A block-paved driveway provides convenient off-street parking to the front. Inside, the welcoming entrance hallway includes a newly renovated guest WC. The separate living room offers a comfortable retreat, with a feature fireplace, fitted cabinetry and shelving.

Extending across the rear of the property, the spacious kitchen, dining and family area is a particular highlight. The newly fitted kitchen features contemporary white cabinetry and new appliances, complemented by modern flooring and generous space for dining and relaxing. Direct access to the garden makes this an ideal setting for everyday family life and entertaining.

Upstairs are three well-proportioned bedrooms, all presented in a fresh, modern style. The main bedroom benefits from fitted wardrobes and an en-suite shower room, while a stylish, newly renovated family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms.

A spacious, floored attic with lighting provides valuable additional storage. This is a storage area and does not form part of the habitable accommodation.

The large, south-facing rear garden is a standout feature, combining a sunny aspect with excellent privacy. A generous lawn, mature trees, established planting and bamboo screening create a beautifully secluded setting, while the paved patio provides an inviting space for outdoor dining and summer entertaining.

The corner position also offers potential to explore an extension to the side or further use of the attic, subject to structural suitability and all necessary planning and building approvals.

Birchdale Road enjoys a convenient Kinsealy location within easy reach of Malahide and Swords, with nearby shops, schools, sporting facilities and transport links. Dublin Airport and the M1 and M50 road networks are also easily accessible.

With its extensive renovations, modern finish throughout, detached design and private south-facing garden, 16A Birchdale Road is a highly appealing turnkey family home.

Early viewing is strongly recommended through Stanley Estate Agents.
